constraints: pathname must be an absolute path; only absolute pathnames are accepted.
Generates a file-manager error (trappable via ON ERR CALL) if pathname is invalid.
If there are no folders at pathname, directories is returned as an empty array.

overloadMerges.note: Fixed 'directories' direction to 'out' (draft defaulted to 'in'); the parameter table marks it with col2 '←' as the array populated with folder names.

params.name: pathname
params.description: Absolute pathname to a volume, directory, or folder

params.name: directories
params.description: Receives the names of the folders located at pathname

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Populates an array with the names of the folders directly located at the given absolute path.
